build_optim_wrapper_with_paramwise_cfg: build an OptimWrapper for a PyTorch model using DefaultOptimWrapperConstructor with custom paramwise learning rate and decay settings
construct_optimizer_with_custom_keys: construct an optimizer with custom_keys to apply different lr_mult and decay_mult to specific model modules like backbone
add_params_with_bias_lr_mult: add model parameters to optimizer param groups with bias_lr_mult to multiply learning rate for all bias parameters
build_optimizer_with_norm_decay_mult: build an optimizer wrapper that applies norm_decay_mult to reduce weight decay for normalization layer parameters
validate_optim_wrapper_cfg: validate the optim_wrapper_cfg and paramwise_cfg dictionaries to ensure required fields like base_wd are present before constructing optimizer
